VBO:0201487.summary: Confidence, zest for life and eagerness to please their family are the traits emphasized in the American Bully standard. The Pocket variety follows that companion standard in a shorter dog, with size determined by adult height and the same breed type and build.
VBO:0201487.shortDescription: The American Bully’s companion ideal in a shorter variety, defined by adult height rather than a different build.

sources.title: ABKC American Bully standard and Pocket variety amendment
sources.evidence: Standard emphasizes confidence, zest for life and eagerness to please/bond with family; this is shared American Bully ideal, not empirical individual guarantee or size-specific personality. Pocket is defined by adult height: male14 to under17in, female13 to under16in; same type/build as Standard, simply shorter. Compact muscular near-square, broad blocky real short-medium muzzle, normal almond/oval eyes, natural ears allowed, strong straight limbs/round compact feet, short glossy coat, full low-set hock-length straight tapering tail carried low relaxed with no curvature/kinks/overback carry. No universal child/stranger/animal suitability, safety, health or obesity claim adopted.

sources.title: Akrama Cantabria — named Don Lee Pocket male
sources.evidence: Own keeper states Don Lee male American Bully Pocket, born2023,42cm; four immediately associated named pictures show developed adult blocky head/real muzzle, compact muscular trunk and short blue/tan/white coat. Photo heights are reported not independently measured. No promotional rarity/lineage/guarantee or individual temperament transferred into public note; no copied subject.
